usedFor: Harvest holds clients and projects, and Capsule CRM holds contacts, so “New Client Created” can run “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client Created” in Harvest, then “Create Contact” in Capsule CRM
bestTemplate.why: Every new client gets a person or organisation record in your CRM, so sales sees who you bill.

watchOut: “New Client Created” in Harvest is polling, so “Create Contact” runs after the next scheduled check, not at once.
